# FinanceGigs

> FinanceGigs is an opt-in candidate pool of finance and accounting professionals, matched to the roles we sync from employers' own career sites.

## Hiring data
- [Finance Hiring Trends](https://financegigs.ai/hiring-trends): the latest month of U.S. finance hiring data from employers' own career sites: open roles by level, remote share, posted pay, skills, certifications and where the jobs are. Updated monthly.
- [Hiring Trends archive](https://financegigs.ai/hiring-trends/archive): every past month, each at its own address.

## Blog
- [FinanceGigs Blog](https://financegigs.ai/blog): plain answers to career questions, from our own job posting data.
- [What is risk and controls work in finance, and who does it?](https://financegigs.ai/blog/finance-risk-and-controls): How often U.S. finance job postings ask for internal controls, SOX, audit and risk management work in 2026, by level.
- [What should finance professionals watch in the 2027 job market?](https://financegigs.ai/blog/finance-job-market-2027): What U.S. finance job postings ask for going into 2027: skills, systems, hybrid work by level, posted pay and the CPA.
- [What does a finance manager earn in 2026?](https://financegigs.ai/blog/finance-manager-salary-2026): Posted pay for U.S. finance managers in 2026, from live roles on employers' own career sites, with every level from Analyst to VP.

## Members and employers
- [Join free](https://app.financegigs.ai/join): roles matched to your profile, by text and email.
- [Use FinanceGigs from an AI assistant](https://app.financegigs.ai/ai): our MCP connector, for searching the roles we're actively matching and reading market data.
- [For employers](https://financegigs.ai/employers)
